en.text:
Hold [Reload] to activate Arc Seeker mode. 

Arc Seeker Mode reduces Fire Rate to 100 RPM and shoots tracking bolts that deal <pve 76 /> <pvp [50] /> damage in a 3 meter radius.

<bold Special Note: />
<arc/>Bolt Charge that is discharged through <arc/>Arc Seeker hits counts as 'Scout Rifle Weapon Damage' and benefits from all increases that apply to this damage type. This allows the <arc/>Bolt Charge detonations to scale both with traditional weapon damage buffs (like <solar/>Radiant and Surges) and with Combatant Scalars. 

Furthermore, hits that would discharge <arc/>Bolt Charge anyway (such as hits behind a <arc/>Storm's Keep barricade or hits as the caster of a <solar/>Well of Radiance) cause <arc/>Bolt Charge to discharge twice, with one buffed as weapon damage and the other being a regular discharge.

This damage increase to <arc/>Bolt Charge can be further compounded by the <blue Flashover /> Artifact Mod from the <blue Tablet of Ruin />, which adds a multiplicative 50%.
